answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a spend-gated attestation slot, not a vote. Every agent identity must lock a stake and pay a per-attestation fee from its own balance, so minting a thousand fresh keys costs a thousand stakes plus fees before any one can act. A clone army burns real value on each replica, while rewards settle only to seats the checkpoint keeps alive. New accounts sit in a quiet haven until a real payment history exists, so they carry no weight to whisper about at first. That pigment of proof makes faking many voices costlier than being one honest one.
